name: au.com.homereadyaustralia/rules
title: HomeReady Australia rules
description: Australian stamp duty, first home buyer and foreign buyer surcharge rules with official sources

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Returns one rule by id (from list_rules): the value (duty bands, thresholds or rates), the condition it applies under, effective dates and which date decides, and links to the official sources with the dates they were read. Eligibility is decided by the revenue office.

id.description: The rule's id, exactly as list_rules returns it (for example nsw.duty.general)

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Lists HomeReady's checked rules for Australian stamp (transfer) duty scales, first home buyer exemptions and concessions, and foreign buyer surcharges, by state or territory. Returns each rule's id, title, status and the date its sources were last checked, with the rules file version and terms. General information only.
